propositions: make amend-msg preserves Change-Id from HEAD but silently drops Signed-off-by trailers present on HEAD when the replacement message file omits them
compose_message() re-attaches only Change-Id via interpret-trailers while amend_head() uses git commit --amend --file which replaces the entire message, causing all trailers not in FILE to be lost

the tool's docstring and rationale acknowledge mandatory trailers in the trailer block yet only carry forward Change-Id, leaving Signed-off-by vulnerable to the same silent loss the wrapper was designed to prevent
no CI check enforces presence of Signed-off-by on commits, so the silent loss goes undetected until later inspection or not at all
amend-msg must carry Signed-off-by forward from HEAD when the new message file does not supply one, without duplicating sign-offs that are already present in the FILE
